lol.headline: A mixed patch focusing on adjusting marksman power and refining utility for tanks and mages, while significantly curbing Lee Sin and Locke.
A diverse patch focusing on strengthening several mid-to-late game carries and tanks while trimming the power of specific marksman tools.
A widespread buffing cycle for diverse roles, paired with targeted nerfs to high-impact utility and scaling champions.
The patch shifts power toward AP assassins and on-hit fighters while curbing the dominance of control mages and high-mobility marksmen.
The patch focuses on empowering high-mobility skirmishers and mages while curbing the dominance of late-game hyper-carries and sustain tanks.
This patch provides significant buffs to several fighters and mages while adjusting the efficiency of sustain and jungle clearing.
